LuxBattleManager_UpdateInputCache_LocalMode
==========================================================================
THE OFFLINE MATCH-REPLAY INPUT CACHE WRITER.  Per-tick function that
caches the current per-slot input at pInputLog->pReplayInputCache[slot]
indexed by (nMasterClock & 0x1FF).

This corrects the WRONG plate on LuxBattleManager_GetCachedRoundValue_-
ByIndex @ 0x1403F0720, which incorrectly claimed "during offline match-
replay viewing the .replay-file pipeline does NOT fill this cache".
THIS function DOES fill it offline.

==========================================================================
DISPATCH PATH
==========================================================================
Called via InputLog vtable[0xCA0] (vtable base 0x143282F18, slot at
0x143283BB8 holds 0x1403F2B60).  vtable[0xCA0] points to
LuxBattleManager_UpdateInputCache_OnlineOrLocal @ 0x1403F2B60 which
routes:
  - pInputLog->dwOnlineActive_at0x4404 == 0  ->  LocalMode (this fn)
  - pInputLog->dwOnlineActive_at0x4404 != 0  ->  inline Online path
                                                 (same algorithm but
                                                  uses +0x4410 instead
                                                  of +0x3A4 as index)

==========================================================================
ALGORITHM (per active player slot)
==========================================================================
  for slot = 0..pInputLog->bEnable_at0x398:
      if (pInputLog->dwForwardReverseBitfield_at0x394 & (1 << slot)) {
          uMaster = pInputLog->nMasterClock_at0x3A4;
          uInput  = *(uint*)(pInputLog + 0x3B8 + slot * 4);
          if ((int)uMaster >= 0) {
              idx = uMaster & 0x1FF;
              entry = pInputLog->pReplayInputCache[slot][idx];
              if (entry.nFrameID == pInputLog->nLastFrameID_at0x3A0 &&
                  entry.dwFrameIndex == uMaster) {
                  if (entry.bFilled) continue;  // already populated this frame
              } else {
                  // overwrite tag
                  entry.nFrameID    = pInputLog->nLastFrameID_at0x3A0;
                  entry.dwFrameIndex= uMaster;
              }
              entry.bFilled     = 1;
              entry.dwInputValue= uInput;
          }
      }

So each player's cache slot at (masterClock & 0x1FF) gets refreshed
every tick from pInputLog+0x3B8+slot*4 (per-slot current input source).

==========================================================================
SOURCE OF +0x3B8 (PER-SLOT CURRENT INPUT)
==========================================================================
The "per-slot current input" array at pInputLog+0x3B8 must be populated
upstream BEFORE this function runs.  Likely populated by:
  - Stage 2 of the replay pipeline (LuxReplay_ConsumeDecodedInputPackets
    @ 0x1403F63B0) — decodes .replay-file packets and (possibly) writes
    them to pInputLog+0x3B8 as a side effect
  - Or by ALuxBattleReplayPlayer's TickActor before this dispatcher fires

TODO: trace exact writers of pInputLog+0x3B8/+0x3BC to confirm.

==========================================================================
HORSEMOD SCRUB IMPLICATIONS
==========================================================================
The HorseMod ReplayScrub IL window restore (pInputLog+0x394..+0x4414)
covers ALL state this writer reads AND writes:
  - +0x394  dwForwardReverseBitfield  (gate)
  - +0x398  bEnable                    (slot count loop bound)
  - +0x39C  dwPlaybackCursor           (used by ReplayPlayer's TickActor)
  - +0x3A0  nLastFrameID               (cache entry tag)
  - +0x3A4  nMasterClock               (cache index for offline)
  - +0x3B8..+0x3BC  per-slot current input (writer reads)
  - +0x3C0..+0x43C0  the cache itself (writer fills)
  - +0x4404 dwOnlineActive             (dispatcher branch select)
  - +0x4410 nDrainCursor               (cache index for online)

So restoring this window AFTER seek-back preserves the writer's
input state and the cache contents at the snapshot frame.  The writer
should resume correctly from the restored masterClock value.

HOWEVER if the upstream that populates +0x3B8 (the per-slot current
input) is gated on chara+0x4400 / chara+0x4424 (the chara replay-state
flags), and those are repurposed for VFX in match-replay viewing per
the older 2026-05-10 plate, then +0x3B8 may NOT be refreshed each tick
in offline match-replay.  In that case the cache gets the SAME stale
input value cached each frame -> chara sees same input forever ->
appears to "stick" at one input.

This matches the observed POST_SEEK behavior of "EngineInput=0x9 for
7 frames, then drops to 0".  The 0x9 may be the snapshot-time stale
value cached repeatedly, and the drop to 0 may be a watchdog/timeout
clearing +0x3B8 or a state-machine transition stopping the dispatcher.
